boundaries: MSAS-01 through MSAS-18 remain the implementation substrates; MSAS-21 is an integration/golden-proof tranche and must not invent a new parallel audio subsystem.
AAI retains canonical audio asset/cue/soundscape/runtime playback/layering/mixer semantics and provider-neutral interoperability.
DWC speech retains constructed-language pronunciation/exact-ID/acoustic-model authority.
ARI/PCA retain generic resource identity, rights/use capability, derivative lineage, provenance, generation, review/locking, registration and localization infrastructure.
World/Environment/Scene/Adventure/Combat/Dialogue/Action/Event owners retain canonical state and occurrence truth.

All 48 PDCP MSAS golden vectors must be evidenced, including provider-off/local-first operation, accessibility, rights/consent, explicit unsupported/lossy interchange and cue-vs-gameplay-truth separation.
Generated audio remains candidate content until explicit acceptance and ARI registration.
Preview/synthetic state cannot infer hidden gameplay state or prove occurrence.
No proprietary middleware, paid/cloud provider or live external service may become a blocking requirement for the golden proof.
MRCS and MVPS lane state remains independent.
